title: finding(plugin-list): the filter candidates read a lookup's display field as `display_field || reference_field`, spellings `FieldSchema` refuses, and never read the declared `displayField`
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a seam defect (class b): a renderer reads the refused spellings of a declared key and never the declared one, so a spec-compliant lookup's display field never reaches the filter's lookup value picker. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#7531 (PR objectui#10544). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Sites (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `c2c4372c2`)

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, the `objectDef.fields` branch of the filter/sort candidate builder: `displayField: field.display_field || field.reference_field`. It reads no `displayField`.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`: `displayField = fieldDef.display_field ?? fieldDef.reference_field`. This is the same read (a source reading, not probed).

## Measured (the dev's probes, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

On the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0:
- `FieldSchema` **accepts** `displayField`;
- it **refuses** `display_field` with the rename hint `display_field` → `displayField`;
- it **refuses** `reference_field` with the hint → `referenceVia`;
- it refuses `id_field` / `idField` with no hint, the same as the nonsense-key control.

A temporary probe run under the verify lock (then deleted): a definition field carrying only `displayField: 'full_name'` gave a candidate with `displayField: undefined`, while `display_field: 'full_name'` gave `'full_name'`. So a spec-compliant object's declared display field never reaches the candidate. The downstream consequence in the FilterBuilder's lookup value picker (labels fall to `r.name`, then `r.label`, then the id) is a code reading, not measured in the UI.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix: read the declared `displayField` (spec first, AGENTS.md 0.1). ⛔ Don't keep the refused spellings as a fallback. `plugin-grid` already converged on `displayField` (`relationalMetaKeys.ts`, objectui#6875 / #7155), so there may be a shared reader to use instead of a third spelling.
- The sibling `idField` read in the same branch has no declared spelling at all. The claimer should say what it becomes.
- Not objectui#7531: that card was the columns-only fallback (a list COLUMN). This is the object-definition branch (a field def).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `display_field` ⇒ PR objectui#10544 (the source), PR objectui#10479 and objectui#7435 (closed; plugin-charts / app-shell readers, a different site). `LookupValuePicker` ⇒ only PR objectui#10544. Must-hit control `UserFilters` ⇒ 10 hits, none on this read.

Dedupe words: `ListView candidateFields display_field` · `filter lookup displayField never read` · `UserFilters display_field reference_field`
